de-DE.landingHint: Verbinden Sie Kategorie und Wert für das Wasserfall-Diagramm
de-DE.Role_Category_Desc: GuV-Zeile, Treiber oder Schritt. Die Feldreihenfolge oder das Feld Reihenfolge bestimmt die Brücke.
de-DE.Role_Value_Desc: Der Betrag jedes Schritts. Negative Werte fallen, positive steigen.
de-DE.Role_Target_Desc: Ziel oder Budget. Als gestrichelte Linie auf den Summenbalken.
de-DE.Role_BarType_Desc: Pro Zeile: total, subtotal oder delta. Alles andere gilt als delta. Erste und letzte Zeile als total markieren. Als Erster aggregieren, nicht Summe.
de-DE.Role_Order_Desc: Numerisches Feld, das die Reihenfolge festlegt. Ohne es folgen die Balken der Kategoriesortierung.
de-DE.Role_Color_Desc: Eine Hex-Farbe pro Zeile, im Modell berechnet. Ersetzt die Farben für Anstieg/Rückgang und die fx-Regel.

de-DE.Landing_Step2: der Betrag jedes Schritts; erste und letzte Zeile sind Summen
de-DE.Landing_Pro: Alle Treiber, Datentabelle und IBCS — beim Bearbeiten mit Ihren Daten ausprobieren.

en-US.landingHint: Connect Category and Value to render the waterfall

en-US.Role_Value_Desc: The amount for each step. Negative values fall, positive values rise.
en-US.Role_Target_Desc: Goal or budget. Drawn as a dashed line on the anchor bars.
en-US.Role_BarType_Desc: Per row: total, subtotal or delta. Anything else is read as delta. Mark the first and last rows as total. Aggregate as First, not Sum.
en-US.Role_Order_Desc: Numeric field that fixes the sequence of the bridge. Without it the bars follow the category sort.
en-US.Role_Color_Desc: A hex colour per row, calculated in the model. Overrides the increase/decrease colours and the fx rule.
en-US.valueLabelColor: Value label color (when not matching bar)
en-US.hideOverlapping: Hide labels that do not fit (Pro)
en-US.anchorLabelsMatchBar: Total / subtotal labels: match bar colour
en-US.textColorAuto: Use the report theme text colour

en-US.Pro_Hide: hiding labels that do not fit
en-US.UI_ProBlocked: Waterfall Advanced: {0} — part of the Pro plan.
en-US.UI_ProDrivers: Waterfall Advanced: showing all {0} drivers individually is part of the Pro plan.

en-US.Landing_Step2: the amount of each step; the first and last rows are totals

dataRoles.name: category
dataRoles.description: The P&L line, driver or step. The field order, or the Order well, defines the bridge.

dataRoles.name: measure
dataRoles.description: The amount for each step. Negative values fall, positive values rise.

dataRoles.name: target
dataRoles.description: Goal or budget. Drawn as a dashed line on the anchor bars.

dataRoles.name: barType
dataRoles.description: Per row: total, subtotal or delta. Anything else is read as delta. Mark the first and last rows as total. Aggregate as First, not Sum.

dataRoles.name: sortOrder
dataRoles.description: Numeric field that fixes the sequence of the bridge. Without it the bars follow the category sort.

dataRoles.name: colorBy
dataRoles.description: A hex colour per row, calculated in the model. Overrides the increase/decrease colours and the fx rule.

positiveColor.description: Fill color for increase bars. Supports rule-based conditional formatting (fx): the rule is resolved per category and overrides the increase/decrease colours for that bar.

valueLabelColor.displayName: Value label color (when not matching bar)

hideOverlapping.displayName: Hide labels that do not fit (Pro)

anchorLabelsMatchBar.displayName: Total / subtotal labels: match bar colour

textColorAuto.displayName: Use the report theme text colour

textColor.displayName: Custom text colour — turn the switch above off
